title: Career Roadmap: AI Engineer
summary: An AI Engineer develops, trains, evaluates, deploys, and maintains artificial intelligence systems that solve real-world problems. AI Engineers combine programming, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, data engineering, and software development to build intelligent applications.

facts.Current degree: BS (4-Year Bachelor of Science - IIT / IISc / Online & Research-oriented)

blocks.text: An AI Engineer develops, trains, evaluates, deploys, and maintains artificial intelligence systems that solve real-world problems. AI Engineers combine programming, mathematics, machine learning, deep learning, data engineering, and software development to build intelligent applications.
Examples include AI chatbots, recommendation engines, computer vision systems, voice assistants, fraud detection systems, autonomous systems, and generative AI applications.

blocks.label: Qualification note
blocks.text: Verify the exact programme title, curriculum, recognition, eligibility requirements, and admission conditions with the institution offering the BS. A degree is the academic foundation; practical projects, internships, software engineering skills, and demonstrated ML competence are also important for AI engineering roles.

sections.heading: What does an AI Engineer do?

items.text: Identify problems that can be solved using AI.
Collect, clean, analyse, and prepare datasets.
Develop machine learning and deep learning models.
Train, validate, and evaluate models using suitable metrics.
Build applications around trained models and AI APIs.
Develop retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and LLM-powered applications.
Deploy AI models through APIs, cloud services, or application infrastructure.
Monitor accuracy, reliability, latency, cost, and model drift.
Address privacy, security, bias, and responsible AI requirements.
Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, product teams, and domain specialists.

blocks.text: Machine Learning Engineer
Builds predictive models, recommendation systems, classification systems, and production ML pipelines.

blocks.label: Key skills
blocks.text: Python, scikit-learn, model evaluation, feature engineering, MLOps
Generative AI Engineer
Develops applications using large language models, RAG, structured outputs, tool calling, and AI agents.

blocks.label: Key skills
blocks.text: LLM APIs, embeddings, vector databases, evaluation, orchestration frameworks
Computer Vision Engineer
Creates systems that interpret images and videos for inspection, medical imaging, object detection, and robotics.

blocks.label: Key skills
blocks.text: OpenCV, CNNs, PyTorch, image processing, object detection
Natural Language Processing Engineer
Builds systems for text classification, search, document extraction, translation, summarisation, and conversational AI.

blocks.label: Key skills
blocks.text: NLP, transformers, tokenisation, embeddings, language-model evaluation
MLOps / AI Platform Engineer
Builds reliable infrastructure for model training, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and scaling.

blocks.label: Key skills
blocks.text: Docker, cloud platforms, CI/CD, experiment tracking, model serving

blocks.text: Year-by-year learning plan
Stage 1
Programming and mathematical foundations

items.text: Learn Python thoroughly, including functions, classes, files, and error handling.
Study linear algebra, calculus basics, probability, and statistics.
Learn SQL and Git/GitHub.
Practise data structures and algorithms.
Build small projects using pandas, NumPy, and matplotlib.

blocks.text: Stage 2
Data science and machine learning

items.text: Learn data preprocessing and exploratory data analysis.
Study regression, classification, clustering, and model selection.
Understand overfitting, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics.
Build projects using scikit-learn.
Practise explaining model performance and limitations.

blocks.text: Stage 3
Deep learning and AI applications

items.text: Learn neural networks and backpropagation.
Use PyTorch or TensorFlow for deep learning projects.
Explore computer vision, NLP, or time-series modelling.
Learn transformers and embeddings.
Build an AI application with a clear user problem and measurable results.

blocks.text: Stage 4
Production AI and job preparation

items.text: Build APIs around trained models.
Learn Docker, cloud deployment, and basic MLOps.
Develop an LLM application with evaluation and safety checks.
Complete an internship, research project, or substantial industry-style project.
Prepare for coding, ML fundamentals, statistics, and AI system-design interviews.

blocks.text: Adapt these stages to the official duration and semester structure of the selected BS programme. Begin applying for internships as soon as you have foundational programming and project experience.

rows.text: LLM APIs, embeddings, structured outputs, tool calling
Vector search, FAISS or a vector database, reranking
MLflow or equivalent experiment and model tracking tools

blocks.text: You do not need to learn all tools at once. Start with Python, SQL, mathematics, and scikit-learn. Add PyTorch and deployment tools after you understand the fundamentals.
Aim for projects that demonstrate problem-solving, measurable performance, sound engineering, and clear documentation.

blocks.label: Project 1
blocks.text: Predictive machine learning system
Build a model for customer churn, demand forecasting, or fraud detection. Compare multiple models and report suitable metrics.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: data preparation, feature engineering, model selection, evaluation

blocks.label: Project 2
blocks.text: Document-based AI assistant
Build a RAG application that answers questions from a controlled document collection, retrieves supporting passages, and acknowledges when evidence is insufficient.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: embeddings, retrieval, LLM integration, evaluation, API development

blocks.label: Project 3
blocks.text: Computer vision application
Develop an object detection, image classification, or visual defect-detection system using an appropriately licensed dataset.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: image preprocessing, deep learning, performance analysis

blocks.label: Project 4
blocks.text: Deployed AI service
Serve a trained model through FastAPI, package it with Docker, and implement logging, validation, error handling, and basic monitoring.

blocks.label: Demonstrates
blocks.text: software engineering, deployment, reliability, production readiness

For every project, publish a README with the problem statement, dataset source, approach, baseline, evaluation results, limitations, setup instructions, and a demonstration. Do not report unverified accuracy or claim that a prototype is production-ready without testing.

blocks.text: Relevant employers and technology ecosystems include Google, Microsoft, Amazon, NVIDIA, Qualcomm, and AI-focused startups and research laboratories. These are examples of relevant organisations, not confirmation of current openings or eligibility.
Students can also gain experience through university research projects, open-source contributions, AI competitions, faculty-led projects, and internships at smaller product companies.
Prioritise practical courses in:

Statistics and probability for machine learning
Machine learning with scikit-learn

Model evaluation, deployment, and MLOps

blocks.text: Certifications can help structure learning, but they do not replace mathematical understanding, strong coding skills, and demonstrable projects.

0 of 8 complete

By graduation, a competitive AI Engineer candidate should aim to have:

items.text: Strong Python programming and quantitative foundations.
A clear understanding of machine learning and deep learning.
Two or three well-documented, technically meaningful projects.
At least one deployed AI application with evaluation results.
Experience using Git, APIs, databases, and basic deployment tools.
Practical exposure through an internship, research project, or open-source work.
The ability to explain model choices, trade-offs, risks, and limitations.

blocks.label: Final recommendation
blocks.text: A BS in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence can provide a suitable foundation for an AI Engineer career. The strongest preparation combines academic fundamentals with consistent programming practice, end-to-end AI projects, deployment experience, and an internship. Students should learn the underlying mathematics and machine learning principles before relying heavily on ready-made AI APIs.
